conditions.active: enchantment present and player not holding Shift
conditions.partial_plane: Wear proportional to successful native mining-wear requests across either level; the established 4/9 or Unbreaking III 1/18 frequency is unchanged.

change.summary: Digger I keeps its native 3x3 mining plane, Digger II uses one 7x7 plane, and both retain native permission, shared highlight, saved toggle and per-success wear frequency.

modifiers.before: Only level I was legal and every active batch and highlight used radius 1.
modifiers.after: The retained enchantment has two legal levels: I mines and highlights one 3x3 plane, II one 7x7 plane. Vanilla table/book/anvil acquisition can produce II, including I plus I on an anvil; no World Tier gate or third level is added.

modifiers.before: BreakEvent recursively mines neighbors whenever enchantment exists, without Shift suppression.
modifiers.after: One native player mining entry captures a batch using active enchantment level I or II; held Shift or disabled enchantment uses ordinary 1x1 native mining. Saved disabled level II re-enables at II.

modifiers.before: Each native block destroy incurs ordinary tool mining wear, potentially nine for a full 3x3 plane.
modifiers.after: Intercept only normal DiggerItem mining wear on successful removals for this exact player/tool/batch. Level I retains four normal requests across nine successful blocks or 0-1 with Unbreaking III; a full level II plane costs 21-22 across 49 successful blocks or 2-3 with Unbreaking III. Unbreaking I/II keep vanilla rolls. Other damage and 1x1 remain vanilla; failed/protected removals do not consume batch mining wear.

modifiers.before: Checks enchantment but does not share Shift state with server area mining.
modifiers.after: Uses the same active level and face-normal pattern as server mining, with the same Shift gate. Enabled state stays on native item enchantment/NBT synchronization; no new packet or parallel toggle state.

rationale.purpose: Preserve native mining and level I behavior while extending the same bounded plane and successful-block wear to level II.
rationale.decision_source: The user requested implementation of the new addendum features on 2026-10-26. Level II 7x7 and the existing toggle/wear contract are supplied in that brief; the shared level-aware pattern is the implementation choice.

introduced.summary: Digger keeps one native 3x3 mining batch with a four-point full-plane wear budget, exact 0/1 wear with Unbreaking III, and shared server/client Shift gating.
